toplead: **Oil above $100 after the US struck Iranian tankers is the tape driver** — the energy pass-through lands in this morning's PPI (08:30 ET) and tomorrow's CPI (Fri 08:30 ET), which together decide the Sep 16 FOMC hike; a confirmed Iran–Oman Hormuz deal or a soft CPI takes the hike off the table.

heads_up.title: Aug PPI 08:30 ET — first inflation read since Brent broke $100
heads_up.desc: Consensus headline +0.3% m/m, core +0.2% (Bloomberg survey). Energy pass-through from the Iranian-tanker strikes (Brent $100.4 on Sep 9) raises the upside-surprise risk; a hot print hardens the ~60% Sep 16 hike odds priced by fed funds futures.

heads_up.title: ORCL Q1 FY27 earnings after the close
heads_up.desc: Only watchlist earnings in the window. Consensus EPS $1.74 adjusted (Yahoo/S&P Global) — Zacks shows $1.39, so the basis matters; revenue $19.13B. Cloud/RPO commentary is the swing factor after the EU cloud-bundling probe was opened Sep 3.

heads_up.title: 30-yr Treasury auction 13:00 ET at a 19-year-high yield
heads_up.desc: $22B reopening prices with the 30-yr at ~5.35%; yesterday's 10-yr tailed 1.4bp with dealers taking 18%. A second tail confirms the duration-demand problem into CPI; a clean stop relieves the long end.

heads_up.title: Aug CPI Fri 08:30 ET — gating print for the FOMC hike
heads_up.desc: Core consensus +0.3% m/m / 2.4% y/y (Cleveland Fed nowcast 2.38%). Lands one hour before the coverage window closes; the Sep 16 decision is effectively priced off this number.

heads_up.title: NVDA ex-dividend today ($0.01) — negligible; SPY ex-div Sep 18 is the one that matters
heads_up.desc: NVDA goes ex today for $0.01 (no assignment risk at that size). SPY's ~$1.85 ex-div on Fri Sep 18 coincides with quad-witching — ITM short calls face early-assignment risk on Sep 17.

conditions_tone: Risk-off open: SPY −0.5% and QQQ −0.9% on the oil spike, VIX up 7% to ~17.7 but still below 20, and the long end pinned at cycle highs (30Y 5.35%) ahead of the auction. Fear & Greed 36 (Fear) is drifting lower without capitulation.

news.text: US Central Command destroyed Iranian crude tankers (Sep 8–9) in retaliation for an IRGC missile attack on a US warship — Brent closed above $100 for the first time since July, and the inflation channel now runs straight into PPI/CPI (WTI +3.5% this morning).
Bloomberg reports an Iran–Oman Strait of Hormuz safe-passage deal is 'days away' — a confirmation would strip the supply premium out of crude as fast as the strikes added it.
Intel plans a ~10% PC CPU price increase effective Oct 5, its third of 2026, prioritising margin over share (DigiTimes; not confirmed by Intel) — INTC +9% Sep 8 then −5.5% Sep 9.

bottom_line: Posture is **risk-off into a two-print inflation gauntlet**: PPI this morning and CPI tomorrow morning decide the Sep 16 hike with oil above $100 doing the pushing, and the 30-yr auction at 13:00 is the intraday rates test. ORCL after the close is the only single-name binary — the consensus basis is split ($1.74 adj. vs $1.39), so judge the reaction on guidance, not the EPS headline. Manage ITM short calls on SPY before the Sep 18 ex-div.
